seo.title: Best Brunch Spots in Antwerp (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover Antwerp's top 12 brunch spots for 2026! From trendy cafes to hidden gems, find the perfect Eggs Benedict, pancakes, or artisanal coffee in Belgium's vibrant city.

hero.subtitle: Antwerp offers a delightful and diverse brunch scene, blending traditional Belgian comfort with international flair. From cozy classic cafes to vibrant, modern eateries, there's a perfect spot for every taste.

picks.name: MOCKa
picks.whyItMadeTheList: MOCKa is a beloved Antwerp institution, famous for its elegant yet relaxed atmosphere and consistently delicious brunch offerings. They pride themselves on fresh, high-quality ingredients and a menu that balances classic favorites with creative twists, making it a perfect spot for a leisurely weekend meal.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Mocka Brunch Plate' with its generous selection of sweet and savory items.
picks.insiderTip: Go early on weekends or be prepared for a short wait, as it's very popular. Their coffee is exceptional, so don't skip a latte!
picks.redditQuote: "Seriously, MOCKa never disappoints. Their brunch plate is massive and everything on it is top-notch. Best coffee in Antwerp too!"

picks.name: Butchers Coffee
picks.whyItMadeTheList: More than just a coffee shop, Butchers Coffee offers a hearty and contemporary brunch experience in a sleek, industrial-chic setting. Known for their specialty coffee and emphasis on fresh, wholesome ingredients, it's a popular spot for a vibrant morning meal.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Avocado Toast Deluxe' paired with their expertly brewed flat white.
picks.insiderTip: They often have unique pastry specials, so check the counter when you arrive. It's a great place to work remotely too, if you snag a good spot.
picks.redditQuote: "Butchers Coffee has the best avocado toast in the city, hands down. Plus, the coffee is next level. Always buzzing!"

picks.name: Maurice Coffee & Brunch
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Maurice Coffee & Brunch offers an aesthetic and delicious experience with its stylish interior and photogenic dishes. It's a favorite among locals and tourists alike for its creative menu, ranging from fluffy pancakes to savory bowls, all served in a bright, inviting space.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Red Velvet Pancakes' or a customizable 'Maurice Bowl'.
picks.insiderTip: Reservations are highly recommended, especially on weekends, as it fills up quickly. It's very Instagram-friendly if you're into that!
picks.redditQuote: "Every time I go to Maurice, I'm amazed by how good everything looks and tastes. Their pancakes are seriously cloud-like."

picks.name: Pistola
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Pistola brings a lively Mediterranean vibe to Antwerp's brunch scene with its bold decor and flavorful dishes. It's known for its shareable plates, excellent cocktails, and a energetic atmosphere that makes it perfect for a festive brunch with friends.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Shakshuka' or their 'Brunch Board' to share, along with a 'Mimosa Kit'.
picks.insiderTip: Come with a group to fully enjoy the sharing concept. Their DJ sets on certain days add to the great ambiance.
picks.redditQuote: "Pistola is such a vibe! Their brunch is delicious and the atmosphere is just so much fun, especially with their cocktails."

picks.name: Tinsel
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Tinsel is a charming, independent cafe tucked away in Zurenborg, offering a seasonal menu focused on fresh, local ingredients. It's praised for its cozy, intimate setting and carefully crafted dishes, providing a truly authentic and high-quality brunch experience.
picks.whatToOrder: Whatever is on their rotating seasonal menu, often featuring creative egg dishes and homemade pastries.
picks.insiderTip: Space is limited, so arriving shortly after opening is a good idea. They have excellent homemade kombucha and lemonades.
picks.redditQuote: "Tinsel is my absolute go-to for a quiet, delicious brunch. Their ingredients are always so fresh and the vibe is super chill."

picks.name: Kaffeenini
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Kaffeenini is a relaxed and popular spot, especially known for its extensive bagel menu and great coffee. It's a perfect choice for a casual, affordable brunch in a laid-back atmosphere, offering plenty of sweet and savory options to suit any craving.
picks.whatToOrder: Any of their freshly baked bagels with a unique topping, like the 'Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese'.
picks.insiderTip: They have a small selection of homemade sweets that are great for taking away. It's a good spot for a quick bite if you're exploring the area.
picks.redditQuote: "If you want a good, cheap bagel brunch, Kaffeenini is the spot. So many options and the coffee is strong!"

picks.name: Nordica 31
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Nordica 31 brings a taste of Scandinavia to Antwerp with its minimalist design and focus on healthy, organic ingredients. Their brunch menu features hearty open-faced sandwiches, fresh bowls, and excellent coffee, all in a serene and light-filled environment.
picks.whatToOrder: A 'Smørrebrød' (open-faced sandwich) with gravlax or their 'Açai Bowl'.
picks.insiderTip: They have a lovely small shop section selling Scandinavian design items and delicacies. Perfect for a unique souvenir.
picks.redditQuote: "Nordica 31 is my favorite for a healthy brunch. Everything feels so fresh and the interior is just beautiful, very calm."

picks.name: WASBAR
picks.whyItMadeTheList: WASBAR offers a truly unique experience: a laundromat combined with a vibrant restaurant. While you wait for your wash, you can enjoy a delicious brunch, from classic breakfast dishes to burgers, in a playful and welcoming setting. It's quirky, fun, and surprisingly good!
picks.whatToOrder: The 'WASBAR Brunch Burger' or a 'Stack of Pancakes'.
picks.insiderTip: Check their website for events like live music or stand-up comedy, which often accompany brunch. Great for solo travelers looking for a unique story.
picks.redditQuote: "Yeah, WASBAR is weird but in the best way. I actually did my laundry AND had a killer brunch there. Their burgers are surprisingly good."

picks.name: Mirlo's
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Mirlo's offers a refined brunch experience in a beautifully designed space with a focus on artisanal and high-quality ingredients. Their menu is thoughtfully curated, presenting classic dishes with an elegant twist, perfect for a special occasion or a more upscale brunch.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Eggs Benedict with Truffle' or their seasonal fruit and yogurt parfait.
picks.insiderTip: Their terrace is lovely in warmer weather. It's a great spot if you want a quieter, more sophisticated brunch.
picks.redditQuote: "Mirlo's is such a gem for a fancy brunch. The interior is stunning and their truffle eggs benedict? Unforgettable."

picks.name: Foodbar L'Epicerie du Cirque
picks.whyItMadeTheList: From the renowned L'Epicerie du Cirque restaurant, their foodbar offers a more casual yet equally gourmet brunch experience. Expect creative, beautifully presented dishes with a focus on seasonal and often surprising flavor combinations in a chic, relaxed setting.
picks.whatToOrder: Whatever is on their ever-changing blackboard menu, often featuring exquisite seafood or unique egg preparations.
picks.insiderTip: This is a great spot to impress a date or celebrate an occasion. Don't hesitate to ask the knowledgeable staff for wine pairing recommendations.
picks.redditQuote: "Foodbar L'Epicerie is high-end but so worth it for a special brunch. Everything is a work of art and tastes incredible."

picks.name: Cuichine
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Cuichine offers a unique twist on brunch with its delightful Asian fusion menu, including a fantastic selection of dim sum and other creative dishes. It's a refreshing alternative to traditional European brunch, served in a modern and inviting space.
picks.whatToOrder: A variety of dim sum, especially the 'Shrimp Har Gow', and their 'Pork Belly Bao Buns'.
picks.insiderTip: Perfect for sharing plates and trying many different items. They have some fantastic bubble tea options too.
picks.redditQuote: "Finally, a place that does Asian brunch right in Antwerp! Cuichine's dim sum are legit and their brunch cocktails are great."

picks.name: Carotterie de Gand
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Carotterie de Gand is a haven for vegetarian and vegan diners, offering a wholesome and delicious plant-based brunch. Their menu focuses on organic, locally sourced produce, crafting creative and flavorful dishes that appeal to everyone, not just those with dietary restrictions.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Vegan Pancakes' with fresh fruit or their seasonal 'Veggie Brunch Plate'.
picks.insiderTip: They have a small shop section with organic groceries and produce. Great for picking up some healthy snacks after brunch.
picks.redditQuote: "Carotterie de Gand saved my vegan brunch quest in Antwerp! Everything is so fresh and flavorful, highly recommend their pancakes."

faq.question: What is the best day to experience brunch in Antwerp?
faq.answer: While many places offer brunch on both Saturdays and Sundays, Sunday is traditionally the most popular day for a leisurely brunch in Antwerp. Weekends generally offer more extensive brunch menus, but some cafes also have great breakfast options during the week. For a more relaxed experience without the crowds, try a Saturday or even a weekday if available.

faq.question: Do I need reservations for brunch in Antwerp?
faq.answer: For popular brunch spots, especially on Sundays, reservations are highly recommended and often essential to avoid long waits. Venues like Maurice Coffee & Brunch and Mirlo's fill up quickly. For smaller, more casual cafes, you might be able to walk in, but it's always best to check their website or call ahead.

faq.question: Are there good vegetarian or vegan brunch options in Antwerp?
faq.answer: Absolutely! Antwerp has a thriving plant-based scene. Many brunch spots, like Carotterie de Gand and Nordica 31, specialize in vegetarian and vegan dishes. Even traditional cafes usually offer several plant-based options or can adapt dishes upon request, making it easy to enjoy a delicious meat-free brunch.

faq.question: What is the typical price range for brunch in Antwerp?
faq.answer: The price for brunch in Antwerp can vary significantly. A casual bagel and coffee might cost around €12-18 / $13-20 per person, while a more elaborate brunch plate or an experience at a trendier spot generally ranges from €18-28 / $20-30. Higher-end or gourmet brunches can go up to €35-45+ / $38-49+ per person, especially if cocktails are included.

faq.question: What makes Antwerp's brunch scene unique?
faq.answer: Antwerp's brunch scene is unique for its blend of traditional Belgian hospitality with international culinary influences. You'll find everything from classic Belgian waffles and pastries to Scandinavian-inspired smørrebrød and Asian fusion dim sum. The city's focus on specialty coffee and stylish, often artistic, cafe interiors also sets it apart.

faq.question: Can I find family-friendly brunch spots in Antwerp?
faq.answer: Yes, many brunch spots in Antwerp welcome families. Places like MOCKa and Kaffeenini offer a relaxed atmosphere with menu items suitable for children. Some, like WASBAR, even provide a fun and engaging environment. It's always a good idea to check if a venue has high chairs or a dedicated kids' menu if you're dining with very young children.

methodology: Our selection of Antwerp's best brunch spots is based on extensive research, including local expert recommendations, popular online reviews, and personal visits. We prioritized venues offering high-quality food, unique ambiance, excellent service, and a diverse menu to cater to various preferences and budgets.
